name: gizza-ai/pdf-form-fill
summary: Fill AcroForm fields in a PDF.

tool.description: Fill the interactive AcroForm fields of a fillable PDF and return the filled PDF. `fields` is a JSON object mapping field names to values (text fields take strings; checkbox/radio fields take the on-state name). Sets NeedAppearances so viewers render the values. Provide the PDF as either url (HTTP/HTTPS) or ref. The response lists which fields were filled and which names were not found.

url.description: Document URL (HTTP/HTTPS). Use either url or ref.

ref.description: Reference id from a prior tool call. Use either url or ref.

fields.description: A JSON object mapping form field names to values, e.g. {"name":"Ada","agree":"Yes"}. Text fields take strings; checkbox/radio (button) fields take the on-state name.
